reason: We have decided to go into the new market and my trade-fair contacts there are thin, so I need meetings now. The 15 companies cost me nothing to look at, and EUR 900 at most is less than one trip to a fair, so I would try it, but only in relationship mode where I approve every company and every message.
objection: My name goes on these messages. If one email goes to the wrong person or looks like spam, buyers in a small market talk, and I do not want a GDPR complaint over an agency's list. One logistics client with 45 meetings is not much proof for wholesale.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 sample companies are ones I already know or obviously wrong for us, I walk away. If they could put me in touch with a wholesaler or distributor they did this for, I would agree faster.
